4. SERVICE INCLUSIONS
Planned Preventive Maintenance: Scheduled visits as per the approved plan, including inspection, cleaning, functional checks and performance verification.

Corrective Maintenance: Valid breakdown calls attended within 24–48 hours from logging, subject to site access, fault condition and parts availability.

Labor Coverage: Labor for covered repair, service and maintenance activities is included during the contract period unless otherwise stated in the approved plan.
5. SERVICE EXCLUSIONS
• Major spare parts, consumables, cosmetic parts and compressor are excluded unless specifically covered under the selected plan.
• Damage due to misuse, negligence, external causes, power surge, fire, flood, unauthorized repair or force majeure is excluded.
• Appliances not listed in the appliance schedule are outside this AMC.
• Out-of-scope work, relocation, installation changes or additional visits will be quoted separately.
6. PAYMENT TERMS AND VALIDITY
Payment Terms: 100% payment in advance is required against the selected AMC plan before service commencement. Services will commence only after receipt of the signed acceptance, confirmed purchase order where applicable, and full advance payment. Prices are in AED and include 5% VAT where shown. This AMC is valid for one year from commencement unless renewed or amended in writing by both parties.

VAS PRICE BANDING & PROFIT SPLIT

Checking data source…
1 PRICING PARAMETERS — EDIT ANY VALUE AND THE WHOLE CARD REPRICES
These are the actual master calculator inputs — the same ones the Excel formula uses (rate %, minimum fee floor, rounding step, service fee tiers, deductible per plan). Change any value and every band below recalculates instantly, the same way Excel's "whole card reprices" behaviour works.
2 COMPUTED PRICE CARD
This is what the portal actually uses to price every VAS sale — fees here are calculated live from the parameters above, not typed in directly. Band label/start/end are editable (and drive their own midpoint); the fee columns are the computed result.
Band LabelStart (AED)End (AED)1-Yr EW2-Yr EW1-Yr DIPremium
3 PROFIT SPLIT — SALES / SERVICE
The percentage of each plan fee that counts as Service revenue vs. Sales revenue. Defaults from the Excel's GP Split sheet — amend here to change what the portal actually applies.
PlanService %Sales %
